llm_analysis.auto_sop_rewrite:
### Parental Leave Policy
The company offers [X] weeks of paid parental leave to support new parents. This policy applies to both mothers and fathers, and the leave can be taken at any time during the first [X] months after the birth or adoption of a child.
### Overall Leave Policy
The company provides [X] days of annual leave, [X] sick leaves, and [X] bereavement leaves. Employees are encouraged to review the Time Off Request and Approval Process document for more information on how to request and approve leave.
